text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... the King is still... a King without a country.
And I am the humble knight who serves him...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(There's no one to look after me, anyway.
If I can't do intense training because of these splints regardless...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I have to support our livelihood!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Since I cannot be in top form for the race,
I shall take care of all the chores instead. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I want to be truly useful and make them happy.
That is the very least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Good work, King.
Your duties seem quite tough...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Shall I brew some tea?
Please, take a breather.
To be honest, I felt like I was leaning on her a bit too much... but I decided to let her make the tea.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(The King just thanked me...
He's expecting great things from me...!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please wait. No, I won't keep you waiting!
I'll bring some delicious tea right away!
(CLAAAASH)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
I'll clean this up right away.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. I imagine you must be quite famished.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please, have a seat over here.
It's nothing grand, but I've prepared lunch.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Here I go, then...
(FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
How is it? I made it myself.
Please, have a taste.
choice_data_list: Th-This is... a full-course meal for lunch?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"It's not really a full-course meal, but...
I just made everything I thought you might enjoy,
and it ended up being this many dishes..."
choice_data_list: I can't eat all of it, though...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I may have misjudged things a bit...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...
Even though I vowed to make sure you wanted for nothing...
It feels like I haven't been of much help at all...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I can't contribute through chores and errands,
then at least... At least...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you will observe my running,
the true calling of a knight."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if my legs aren't at their best, I'll run a decent race!
I'll show growth that brings everyone joy!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!
choice_data_list: Durandal, the pace is too fast, too fast!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King, pray, behold!
Haaaaaaah!"
Lately, I feel like I haven't been able to run while saving my legs properly...
Strengthening the master-servant bond... But it felt as though the more time I spent with Durandal, the worse everything went...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ugh, impossible...
To think it would end like this...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This wasn't... supposed to happen!
How could this..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King... I promise to devote myself even further from now on.
So please, anything but banishment...
choice_data_list: I get it, so calm down!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I deeply regret what happened.
I will... definitely make up for this blunder.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "She's likely just not used to serving in the palace yet. We will improve things little by little, step by step."
(CLAAAASH!)

"Even so, even after some time passed,
calmness was slow to return."

"Durandal gradually fell deeper
and deeper into an irregular lifestyle."
